name: Best Friend Or Deadly Lie
overview: In her past life, Florencia Salazar was betrayed by her "best friend," Daniela Vargas, ultimately ending up alone and murdered by her. Upon being reborn, Florencia uncovers Daniela's lies, evades her traps, and—with the help of Santiago Herrera, who had always quietly protected her—exposes Daniela's true nature and makes her pay for her crimes.
